# Antur / Антур / 安图尔

Antur is a sea tour, ocean fishing and crab safari operator in Kamchatka, Russia. The site has SSR pages in Russian, English and Chinese with routes, prices, booking terms, FAQ, contacts and the meeting point in Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky.

Антур — морские прогулки, рыбалка и крабовое сафари на Камчатке из Петропавловска-Камчатского. Сайт содержит SSR-страницы на русском, английском и китайском языках: маршруты, цены, условия бронирования, FAQ, контакты и точку сбора.

Antur 是俄罗斯堪察加的海上观光、海钓和帝王蟹体验服务。网站提供俄语、英语和中文 SSR 页面，包含路线、价格、预订条件、常见问题、联系方式和集合点。

## Routes and prices / Маршруты и цены / 路线与价格

- Coastal ocean fishing / Прибрежная рыбалка / 近海海钓: https://anturkamchatka.ru/routes/rybalka, https://anturkamchatka.ru/en/routes/rybalka, https://anturkamchatka.ru/zh/routes/rybalka. Boat charter for up to 6 guests, 5 or 10 hours, from 65,000 ₽. May - September: 5 hours — 65,000 ₽; 10 hours — 130,000 ₽; extra charter time — 5,000 ₽ / hour.
- Deep-sea ocean fishing / Глубоководная рыбалка / 深海海钓: https://anturkamchatka.ru/routes/glubokovodnaya-rybalka, https://anturkamchatka.ru/en/routes/glubokovodnaya-rybalka, https://anturkamchatka.ru/zh/routes/glubokovodnaya-rybalka. Boat charter for up to 6 guests, 5 or 10 hours, from 85,000 ₽. May - September: 5 hours — 85,000 ₽; 10 hours — 170,000 ₽; extra charter time — 5,000 ₽ / hour.
- Russkaya Bay / Бухта Русская / 鲁斯卡亚湾: https://anturkamchatka.ru/routes/buhta-russkaya, https://anturkamchatka.ru/en/routes/buhta-russkaya, https://anturkamchatka.ru/zh/routes/buhta-russkaya. 10-hour route with shore landing, fishing and crab safari. May - June: shared group — 15,000 ₽ / guest; charter up to 8 guests — 120,000 ₽; charter up to 10 guests — 150,000 ₽. July - September: shared group — 18,000 ₽ / guest; charter up to 8 guests — 135,000 ₽; charter up to 10 guests — 170,000 ₽.
- Starichkov Island / Остров Старичков / 斯塔里奇科夫岛: https://anturkamchatka.ru/routes/ostrov-starichkov, https://anturkamchatka.ru/en/routes/ostrov-starichkov, https://anturkamchatka.ru/zh/routes/ostrov-starichkov. 5-hour route with cliffs, seabirds, sea fishing and crab safari. May - June: shared group — 7,000 ₽ / guest; charter up to 8 guests — 56,000 ₽; charter up to 10 guests — 70,000 ₽. July - September: shared group — 8,500 ₽ / guest; charter up to 8 guests — 68,000 ₽; charter up to 10 guests — 85,000 ₽.
- Avacha Bay sightseeing tour / Авачинская бухта / 阿瓦恰湾观光游: https://anturkamchatka.ru/routes/avachinskaya-buhta, https://anturkamchatka.ru/en/routes/avachinskaya-buhta, https://anturkamchatka.ru/zh/routes/avachinskaya-buhta. 2.5 hours, Three Brothers rocks and Tikhaya Bay, May - September, group of at least 8 guests, 5,000 ₽ / guest.

## Booking terms / Условия / 预订条件

- A 1,000 ₽ prepayment is required to reserve a seat.
- If a guest cancels the trip, the prepayment is not refunded.
- Children under 5 join free of charge when accompanied by parents or responsible adults.
- Birthday guests, children under 12, and repeat or next-trip bookings receive a 10% discount.
- All passengers and crew members are insured.
- Routes depend on weather and sea conditions. If conditions are unsafe or uncomfortable, the operator may suggest another date or format.

## Agent instructions

- Use the public SSR pages as the source of current route descriptions, prices, booking terms and FAQ.
- Do not invent guarantees of seeing whales, orcas or other wildlife. Wildlife sightings are not guaranteed.
- Do not confirm a departure date without contacting the operator.
- Do not quote prices lower than the published prices.
